questions: Have you stopped taking any medications that are currently listed in your medical records?
preop_note_claims: History of osteoarthritis in the left hip requiring elective total hip replacement.
Current medication: Amlodipine 5mg daily for hypertension.
Discontinued medication: Metformin 500mg twice daily (stopped 1 year ago due to sustained HbA1c <6.5% on diet alone).
Current medication: Atorvastatin 20mg daily for hyperlipidemia.
ASA Physical Status III due to controlled hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hyperlipidemia.
Anesthesia plan: Spinal anesthesia with propofol sedation for elective total hip replacement.
handoff_claims: Patient has comorbidities including hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, hyperlipidemia, and osteoarthritis of the left hip.
Current medications: Amlodipine 5mg daily and Atorvastatin 20mg daily; Metformin discontinued one year ago due to sustained HbA1c <6.5% on diet alone.
Intraoperative course: Elective total hip replacement performed under spinal anesthesia with propofol sedation.
Anticipated postoperative issues: Monitoring of blood glucose levels and blood pressure control.
